hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); print(f)" | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == */backend/*.php ]]; then rel="${f#*backend/}"; docker compose exec -T backend vendor/bin/pint "$rel" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
